gaps.topic: Symptoms, deterioration and a personal action plan
gaps.current_coverage: Symptoms listed; generic emergency banner, exercise stop/rest advice and carer monitoring exist. No joined-up action plan.
gaps.proposed_location: /understanding-ph and linked short safety article; cross-links from living/carer pages
gaps.deliverable: Explain emergency vs same-day team contact vs routine questions; country-labelled contacts, personal team/after-hours plan and infusion exception.
gaps.proposed_review_role: Clinician Advisory Panel and PH nurse
gaps.publication_gate: Draft, review and publish within the existing navigation; no new collection service.

gaps.topic: Pregnancy, contraception and reproductive decisions
gaps.current_coverage: No substantive patient article; a medication-list context cannot substitute for counselling.
gaps.proposed_location: /living-well under Your care; links from treatments
gaps.deliverable: Sensitive, current risk communication, preconception advice, unplanned-pregnancy contact, medicine-specific precautions, contraception interactions and specialist counselling. No unsupported blanket mortality percentage.
gaps.proposed_review_role: PH clinician, reproductive-health specialist and lived-experience reviewers
gaps.publication_gate: Draft, review and publish within the existing navigation; no new collection service.

gaps.topic: Medicine safety, monitoring, supply and interruption

gaps.publication_gate: Draft, review and publish within the existing navigation; no new collection service.

gaps.topic: CTEPH as a distinct diagnosis and treatment journey
gaps.current_coverage: One accordion and short PEA/BPA/riociguat mentions.

gaps.publication_gate: Draft, review and publish within the existing navigation; no new collection service.

gaps.topic: Other PH groups and treatment boundaries
gaps.current_coverage: Five-group introduction; medicine overview mostly PAH-focused.

gaps.publication_gate: Draft, review and publish within the existing navigation; no new collection service.

gaps.topic: WHO functional class, groups, risk and test trends
gaps.current_coverage: Five groups and some test numbers present; no clear functional-class/risk explanation.

gaps.proposed_review_role: Clinician Advisory Panel
gaps.publication_gate: Draft, review and publish within the existing navigation; no new collection service.

gaps.topic: What to expect from investigations

gaps.publication_gate: Draft, review and publish within the existing navigation; no new collection service.

gaps.publication_gate: Draft, review and publish within the existing navigation; no new collection service.

gaps.topic: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander cultural safety
gaps.current_coverage: No tailored clinical/resource pathway beyond general Australia coverage.

gaps.topic: Real community voices

gaps.publication_gate: Draft, review and publish within the existing navigation; no new collection service.
